name: Vienna: Nussdorf vineyards to the Kahlenberg
why: Out of the city on Vienna's city hiking trail 1, through the vineyards and wine taverns of Nussdorf and Grinzing to a hill over the whole of Vienna and the Danube.
book: Free. Tram D to Nussdorf; bus 38A back from the Kahlenberg.
water: Heurige wine taverns on the way.
dangers: Short steep stretch on the Nasenweg.

points.name: Nussdorf
points.note: The tram terminus among wine taverns.

points.name: Kahlenberg
points.note: A wooded hill with a church and the view over Vienna.
